notes: #3 (Ozanne, 1776) is a good print but the town is a thin strip on the horizon and #1 covers P3. #2 (1838) shows mostly beach and forts. #5 and #9 show Saint-Servan, then a separate town; the Paramé photochroms (#4, #6, #8) show the seaside resort, not the old town. The 1944 photos are a road, a ruined house and a train wreck outside the town. #14 (2013) is a sharper modern alternative but framed by blurred rampart stones and shows only the cathedral quarter.
